title: in vain — privileged

sentences.sentence: the threat of compulsory redundancies
sentences.translation: 强制性裁员的威胁

sentences.sentence: Car insurance is compulsory.
sentences.translation: 汽车保险是强制性的。

sentences.sentence: Meanwhile, researchers are thinking about gene-therapy trials for other inherited retinal diseases as well as for more common disorders such as macular degeneration.
sentences.translation: 同时，研究者正考虑为其他遗传性视网膜疾病和诸如黄斑变性等的常见病进行基因治疗试验。

sentences.sentence: This paper introduce the differences in thymidine kinase(TK) isoenzymes and the relation of them to cancer and cell cycle as well as the progress of gene-therapy of cancer based on tk gene.
sentences.translation: 重点介绍了各种胸苷激酶（TK）同工酶的差异及其与癌症和细胞周期的关系，并介绍了最近利用tk基因进行肿瘤基因治疗研究的进展。

sentences.sentence: And the participants will be monitored for 15 years for health impacts, as is required by the FDA for any gene-therapy trials.
sentences.translation: 根据FDA对任何基因疗法试验的要求，试验参与者将要接受为期15年的监测，以明确该疗法的健康影响。

保安巡逻，对安全的威胁；安全感胁
紧迫的威胁；逼近的威胁

sentences.translation: 你的那些威胁吓不倒我。

sentences.translation: 对他妻儿的威胁

sentences.sentence: Nichols never carried out his threat to resign.
sentences.translation: 尼科尔斯威胁过要辞职，但从未付诸行动。

sentences.sentence: The government will not give in to terrorist threats .
sentences.translation: 政府不会屈服于恐怖分子的威胁。

sentences.sentence: She dismissed the statement as an empty threat .
sentences.translation: 她无视这项声明，认为是个空口威胁。

sentences.sentence: They warned him with veiled threats not to mention anything he had witnessed.
sentences.translation: 他们话中有话地威胁他不要提及他所目睹的事。

sentences.sentence: The police are investigating death threats made against the two men.
sentences.translation: 警方正在调查针对这两名男子的死亡恐吓。

sentences.sentence: Officials at the school say they received a bomb threat at approximately 11:30 a.m. today.
sentences.translation: 学校的官员说他们在今天上午11点半左右收到过炸弹恐吓。

sentences.sentence: the controversial issue of welfare reform
sentences.translation: 福利改革这一有争议的话题

sentences.translation: 一个把山谷淹掉来建造水坝的极具争议的计划

sentences.sentence: He is a controversial figure (= person who does controversial things ) in the art world.
sentences.translation: 他是艺术界极具争议的人物。

sentences.sentence: Congress is continuing to oppose the President’s health care budget.
sentences.translation: 国会继续反对总统的医疗保健预算。

sentences.translation: 波士顿马拉松赛

sentences.translation: 加西亚用了不到三小时就跑完了马拉松。

sentences.translation: 目击者的说法互相矛盾，真相依然未明。

sentences.sentence: 34 protesters were arrested for violating criminal law.
sentences.translation: 34名抗议者因违反刑法而被逮捕。

sentences.translation: 侵犯人权的政权

translations.translation: 不管多大代价，无论如何

sentences.sentence: Moreover, our culture and the media convince us that unless we hold on to our youth at all costs, we will face terrible losses.
sentences.translation: 而且，这个时代的文化氛围和媒体让我们相信，我们必须要以任何代价让青春永驻，不然我们将失去很多。

sentences.translation: 眼睛把光信号转变成神经冲动。

sentences.translation: 她是她母亲的缩影。

sentences.translation: 这部电影随着故事的进行愈发黑暗，其原声带亦如此。

sentences.sentence: Lose the speaker cables without losing a single detail from the soundtrack.
sentences.translation: 没有扬声器电缆却没有从声道失去哪怕一个单一的音节。

sentences.sentence: The scenes of torture, all conducted by willing collaborators, are truly sickening, as in another way are the pro-Nazi propaganda broadcasts that figure regularly on the soundtrack.
sentences.translation: 酷刑的场景非常可怖，全部由协作者们自愿拍摄完成，从另一方面来看正是那些电影原声带上经常描绘的鼓吹纳粹的宣传画。

sentences.sentence: They spoke good Spanish, and promised to interpret for me.
sentences.translation: 他们西班牙语说得很好，答应替我翻译。

sentences.sentence: He was too far away to be able to identify faces.
sentences.translation: 他离得太远，没法看面孔认出谁是谁。

sentences.sentence: The police took fingerprints and identified the body.
sentences.translation: 警方采集了指纹，对尸体作了身份确认。

sentences.sentence: Her voice was full of emotion.
sentences.translation: 她的声音充满了激情。

sentences.sentence: She was good at hiding her emotions.
sentences.translation: 她很会掩饰自己的情感。

sentences.sentence: Kim received the news without showing any visible sign of emotion.
sentences.translation: 金接到消息时丝毫不露声色。

sentences.sentence: Kylie feels fortunate to be in such a privileged position because of her successful TV career.
sentences.translation: 凯莉觉得由于成功的电视生涯而使自己处于这样优越的地位真是幸运。

text:
英语词汇 · 北师高中 · 第 98 单元

in vain
徒然，白费力气

compulsory
音标：英 /kəmˈpʌlsərɪ/  美 /kəmˈpʌlsərɪ/
adj. 强制性的，义务的
短语：compulsory education — 义务教育
短语：compulsory course — 必修课
短语：compulsory insurance — 强制保险
短语：compulsory license — 强制许可
短语：nine-year compulsory education — 九年制义务教育
短语：compulsory subject — 必修课
短语：compulsory execution — 强制执行
短语：compulsory measure — 强制手段
短语：compulsory exercise — 规定动作
短语：china compulsory certification — 中国强制认证（3C认证）
短语：compulsory purchase — 强制购买
例句：the threat of compulsory redundancies
强制性裁员的威胁
例句：Car insurance is compulsory.
汽车保险是强制性的。

at random
随便地，随意地

gene-therapy
基因疗法
例句：Meanwhile, researchers are thinking about gene-therapy trials for other inherited retinal diseases as well as for more common disorders such as macular degeneration.
同时，研究者正考虑为其他遗传性视网膜疾病和诸如黄斑变性等的常见病进行基因治疗试验。
例句：This paper introduce the differences in thymidine kinase(TK) isoenzymes and the relation of them to cancer and cell cycle as well as the progress of gene-therapy of cancer based on tk gene.
重点介绍了各种胸苷激酶（TK）同工酶的差异及其与癌症和细胞周期的关系，并介绍了最近利用tk基因进行肿瘤基因治疗研究的进展。
例句：And the participants will be monitored for 15 years for health impacts, as is required by the FDA for any gene-therapy trials.
根据FDA对任何基因疗法试验的要求，试验参与者将要接受为期15年的监测，以明确该疗法的健康影响。

threat
音标：英 /θret/  美 /θrɛt/
n. 威胁
短语：pose a threat — 构成威胁；形成一种威胁
短语：security threat — 保安巡逻，对安全的威胁；安全感胁
短语：triple threat — （美）三面手
短语：imminent threat — 紧迫的威胁；逼近的威胁
例句：Your threats don’t scare me.
你的那些威胁吓不倒我。
例句：threats made against his wife and children
对他妻儿的威胁
例句：Nichols never carried out his threat to resign.
尼科尔斯威胁过要辞职，但从未付诸行动。
例句：The government will not give in to terrorist threats .
政府不会屈服于恐怖分子的威胁。
例句：She dismissed the statement as an empty threat .
她无视这项声明，认为是个空口威胁。
例句：They warned him with veiled threats not to mention anything he had witnessed.
他们话中有话地威胁他不要提及他所目睹的事。
例句：The police are investigating death threats made against the two men.
警方正在调查针对这两名男子的死亡恐吓。
例句：Officials at the school say they received a bomb threat at approximately 11:30 a.m. today.
学校的官员说他们在今天上午11点半左右收到过炸弹恐吓。

controversial
音标：英 /kɒntrə'vɜːʃ(ə)l/  美 /,kɑntrə'vɝʃl/
adj. 有争议的
例句：the controversial issue of welfare reform
福利改革这一有争议的话题
例句：a highly controversial (= very controversial ) plan to flood the valley in order to build a dam
一个把山谷淹掉来建造水坝的极具争议的计划
例句：He is a controversial figure (= person who does controversial things ) in the art world.
他是艺术界极具争议的人物。

oppose
音标：英 /ə'pəʊz/  美 /ə'poz/
vt. 反对
例句：Congress is continuing to oppose the President’s health care budget.
国会继续反对总统的医疗保健预算。

dash
音标：英 /dæʃ/  美 /dæʃ/
n. 短跑
短语：dash forward — 插上；向前冲
短语：a dash of — 少许；一点儿
短语：dash in — 急写
短语：dash off — v. 匆忙完成
短语：cut a dash — 大出风头；摆阔
短语：dash along — v. 滔滔不绝
短语：dash out — v. 冲出，跑开；删去，勾掉
短语：em dash — n. 长破折号

marathon
音标：英 /'mærəθ(ə)n/  美 /'mærə,θɑn/
n. 马拉松赛跑
短语：boston marathon — 波士顿马拉松赛
例句：the Boston Marathon
波士顿马拉松赛
例句：Garcia ran the marathon in just under three hours.
加西亚用了不到三小时就跑完了马拉松。

contradict
音标：英 /kɒntrə'dɪkt/  美 /'kɑntrə'dɪkt/
vt. 与（其他事物）相矛盾
短语：contradict oneself — 自相矛盾
例句：The witness statements contradict each other and the facts remain unclear.
目击者的说法互相矛盾，真相依然未明。

violate
音标：英 /'vaɪəleɪt/  美 /'vaɪəlet/
vt. 违反，违背
例句：34 protesters were arrested for violating criminal law.
34名抗议者因违反刑法而被逮捕。
例句：regimes that violate human rights
侵犯人权的政权

at all costs
不管多大代价，无论如何
例句：Moreover, our culture and the media convince us that unless we hold on to our youth at all costs, we will face terrible losses.
而且，这个时代的文化氛围和媒体让我们相信，我们必须要以任何代价让青春永驻，不然我们将失去很多。

impulse
音标：英 /'ɪmpʌls/  美 /'ɪmpʌls/
n. 脉冲
短语：impulse response — 脉冲响应
短语：on impulse — 一时冲动，一时心血来潮
短语：impulse noise — 脉冲噪声，冲激噪声
短语：impulse voltage — 冲击电压；冲荤压；脉冲电压
短语：impulse response function — 响应函数；脉冲响应函数；反应函数
短语：impulse control — 脉冲控制；冲动控制
短语：specific impulse — 比冲量；比推力
短语：nerve impulse — [医]神经冲动
短语：impulse test — [电]冲击试验
短语：impulse force — 冲击力
短语：impulse turbine — 冲力式涡轮机；冲击式汽轮机；水戽式（冲击式）水轮机
短语：impulse function — 脉冲函数；冲力函数；冲击函数
短语：impulse buying — 即兴购买；未经考虑仅凭一时冲动的购物行为
例句：The eye converts light signals to nerve impulses.
眼睛把光信号转变成神经冲动。

complicated
音标：英 /'kɒmplɪkeɪtɪd/  美 /'kɑmplɪketɪd/
adj. 复杂的
短语：complicated structure — 复式构造
短语：complicated fault — 复杂断层
短语：be complicated by — 并发
例句：a complicated pattern
复杂的图案
例句：The human brain is an incredibly complicated organ.
人脑是一个结构极其复杂的器官。

miniature
音标：英 /'mɪnɪtʃə/  美 /ˈmɪniətʃɚ; ˈmɪnɪtʃɚ/
n. 微型复制品
短语：in miniature — 小型；小规模
短语：miniature schnauzer — 迷你雪纳瑞
短语：miniature golf — 小型高尔夫游戏；小小高尔夫球
短语：miniature bearing — 微型轴承
短语：miniature circuit breaker — 小型断路器；微型电路继电器；保险丝壳；跳菲
短语：miniature camera — n. 小型照像机
例句：She’s her mother in miniature.
她是她母亲的缩影。

soundtrack
音标：英 /'saʊn(d)træk/  美 /'saʊndtræk/
n. 声迹
例句：This movie gets darker with every scene and so does the soundtrack.
这部电影随着故事的进行愈发黑暗，其原声带亦如此。
例句：Lose the speaker cables without losing a single detail from the soundtrack.
没有扬声器电缆却没有从声道失去哪怕一个单一的音节。
例句：The scenes of torture, all conducted by willing collaborators, are truly sickening, as in another way are the pro-Nazi propaganda broadcasts that figure regularly on the soundtrack.
酷刑的场景非常可怖，全部由协作者们自愿拍摄完成，从另一方面来看正是那些电影原声带上经常描绘的鼓吹纳粹的宣传画。

interpret
音标：英 /ɪn'tɜːprɪt/  美 /ɪn'tɝprɪt/
vt. 翻译；解释
短语：right to interpret — 解释权
例句：They spoke good Spanish, and promised to interpret for me.
他们西班牙语说得很好，答应替我翻译。

identify
音标：英 /aɪ'dentɪfaɪ/  美 /aɪ'dɛntɪfaɪ/
vt. 确定；认出，识别
短语：identify oneself — 证明自己(的身份)
短语：identify with — 认为…等同于，与一致
例句：He was too far away to be able to identify faces.
他离得太远，没法看面孔认出谁是谁。
例句：The police took fingerprints and identified the body.
警方采集了指纹，对尸体作了身份确认。

emotion
音标：英 /ɪ'məʊʃ(ə)n/  美 /ɪ'moʃən/
n. 情感，情绪
短语：with emotion — 激动地；感动地
短语：intense emotion — 激情
短语：emotion quotient (EQ) — 情商
短语：emotion quotient (eq) — 情商
例句：Her voice was full of emotion.
她的声音充满了激情。
例句：She was good at hiding her emotions.
她很会掩饰自己的情感。
例句：Kim received the news without showing any visible sign of emotion.
金接到消息时丝毫不露声色。

privileged
音标：英 /'prɪvəlɪdʒd/  美 /'prɪvəlɪdʒd/
adj. 荣幸的
短语：privileged position — 特权地位；最优惠头寸
例句：Kylie feels fortunate to be in such a privileged position because of her successful TV career.
凯莉觉得由于成功的电视生涯而使自己处于这样优越的地位真是幸运。
